name: Ratatoskr
summary: Explicitly save pages and selected text to your Ratatoskr archive.
description: Explicitly save the current page, a link, or selected text to your paired Ratatoskr deployment.
Captures are user initiated, queued durably, and submitted with stable idempotency. Ratatoskr does not read provider cookies, browser history, passwords, or hidden network traffic.
Reviewed extension permissions: activeTab, alarms, contextMenus, storage. Platform origin access is optional and granted only for the HTTPS deployment selected by the user.
